title: Sheep with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wool' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e8e4f5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c9c2de'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wool2' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f4f1ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b9b0d4'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='face' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd9c2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8a98c'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shine' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#bff4ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='7' height='15' rx='3' fill='#8d7a6a'/>
  <rect x='57' y='74' width='7' height='15' rx='3' fill='#8d7a6a'/>
  <rect x='34' y='86' width='11' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5e4f6e'/>

  <!-- fluffy body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='url(#wool)'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='54' r='10' fill='url(#wool2)'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='54' r='10' fill='url(#wool2)'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='45' r='9' fill='url(#wool2)'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='45' r='9' fill='url(#wool2)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='10' fill='url(#wool2)'/>

  <!-- head wool -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='34' r='9' fill='url(#wool2)'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='34' r='9' fill='url(#wool2)'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='27' r='8' fill='url(#wool2)'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='27' r='8' fill='url(#wool2)'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='42' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#e8a98c' transform='rotate(-20 18 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='42' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#e8a98c' transform='rotate(20 82 42)'/>

  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='20' ry='17' fill='url(#face)'/>

  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='5.5' fill='#2a1f4a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='5.5' fill='#2a1f4a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='3.6' fill='#8e6fff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='3.6' fill='#8e6fff'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='40' r='2.1' fill='url(#shine)'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='40' r='2.1' fill='url(#shine)'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='44.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M46 33 l1 2.4 2.4 1 -2.4 1 -1 2.4 -1 -2.4 -2.4 -1 2.4 -1z' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <path d='M62 33 l1 2.4 2.4 1 -2.4 1 -1 2.4 -1 -2.4 -2.4 -1 2.4 -1z' fill='#fff6b0'/>

  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='2.6' ry='1.8' fill='#a55e6b'/>
  <path d='M50 52 q-3 3 -5 1' stroke='#a55e6b' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 52 q3 3 5 1' stroke='#a55e6b' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='51' r='2.6' fill='#ff9d9d' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='51' r='2.6' fill='#ff9d9d' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- little bow -->
  <path d='M48 60 l-7 -4 0 8z' fill='#ff7fb0'/>
  <path d='M52 60 l7 -4 0 8z' fill='#ff7fb0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='2.4' fill='#ff4f94'/>
</svg>
